scope: M-B/M-F source, schema, identity, split, and rights audit for the official Recipe1MSubs/GISMo inputs

upstream_code_checkout.license_scope: Repository code only; not treated as a license for external benchmark payloads or upstream recipe/comment content

source_and_identity_findings.paper_provenance: The authors describe extracting substitution pairs from comments on websites associated with Recipe1M recipes.
source_and_identity_findings.paper_identity_contract: Each benchmark item contains a directional substitution pair and a Recipe1M recipe ID; train/validation/test assignment follows the Recipe1M recipe-ID splits.

upstream_record_fields.subs: Two-item source and target ingredient substitution tuple

upstream_translation_behavior: For each ingredient synonym list, select the first vocabulary match and stop searching that list.
Collapse translated recipe ingredients into a set of vocabulary IDs.
Exclude a row if fewer than two recipe ingredients map, or if the source or target ingredient is absent from the vocabulary.
Report aggregate missing-ingredient and dropped-row counters by split; the translated output does not retain a per-source-row refusal record or comment/source URL.
unverified_identity_items: The exact Recipe1M release, its source files, split-file hashes, and authorized join inputs are not present in the checkout.
No original website/comment identifier or per-comment source URL is exposed by the audited upstream loader contract.
Current payload hashes, actual row counts, duplicate IDs/pairs, denominator retention, and byte-identical regeneration have not been verified.

gismo_repository.readme_statement: The majority of ingredient-substitution is licensed under CC-BY-NC.
gismo_repository.coverage_of_the_three_external_pickle_fi: Not explicitly mapped in the README/license notice; exact file coverage remains unconfirmed.

recipe1m_and_comment_source.recipe1m_access: GISMo README says Recipe1M access requires registration.
recipe1m_and_comment_source.source_content: The benchmark paper describes mining user comments from Recipe1M-associated recipe websites.

use_boundary.status: Do not infer that the Apache-2.0 code license covers dataset files or third-party recipe/comment content. Obtain precise rights confirmation before product use or redistribution.
